issue.title: Headless Chromium screenshots intermittently hang on apollo; preview harnesses hang without CDP timeouts and orphan browsers
issue.description:
bob-cli-fl.6.1.5 note #1 listed `task-link-motion reduced-motion` among seven full `npm test` failures on 2026-11-02, saying it reproduces on the clean base or passes in isolation.

Independent observation by the bob-cli-fl.6.1 land agent on apollo, 2026-11-02 at about 16:00–16:25 EST (bob-plugins 806ba69):
- For about 20 minutes, every CDP `Page.captureScreenshot` from a fresh headless Chromium hung indefinitely. That included a trivial one-line "hello" page, both `chromium-1248/chrome-linux64/chrome` and `chrome-headless-shell`, and captures with and without `fromSurface`/`captureBeyondViewport`. Phase-3 Stats preview pages that pass in 14 s also hung during that window. `Debugger.pause` showed the page idle, not busy.
- About 30 minutes later the same trivial-page captures took about 50 ms, and `node --test scripts/test-task-link-marks-motion.cjs` passed 2/2 (about 2.3 s each). This is the same tree, with no code change in between.
- Fail rate is unknown. It is not tied to one test: any Chromium-screenshot test or harness (task-link-marks preview and motion test, preview-stats-block.cjs, preview-day-strip.cjs) is exposed while the host is in this state.
- Orphans pile up. Three headless browsers with `--user-data-dir=/tmp/bob-task-link-marks-chromium-*`, started 00:19–01:09, were still alive 16 h later (parent PID 1). Killing the preview harnesses with `timeout` also left `--type=gpu-process` and crashpad orphans. The harnesses spawn Chromium without a process group and kill only the main PID in `finally`, which never runs on SIGTERM. Their CDP client (`call()` in scripts/preview-*.cjs) has no per-call timeout, so a stalled capture hangs the harness forever. `test-task-link-marks-motion.cjs` is bounded only by spawnSync's 90 s timeout.

Suggested scope: add per-call CDP timeouts and process-group cleanup (spawn detached, kill -pid on exit or signal) to the shared preview harnesses. Then find what wedges Chromium captures on apollo (orphan accumulation, swiftshader GPU process, or load) and make the Chromium-backed tests fail fast with a clear message rather than hang.
